blocks.text: Product Description Discover the ASUS Vivobook 14, the ultimate companion for seamless productivity and entertainment. Powered by the 13th Gen Intel Core i5-1334U processor, it effortlessly handles multitasking, ensuring swift responses for all your daily office tasks, study sessions, and entertainment needs. The integrated Intel UHD Graphics enhances your visual experience, making it perfect for both work and play. Featuring a 14-inch FHD anti-glare display with a 1920x1080 resolution, 60Hz refresh rate, and 250 nits brightness, it offers sharp visuals and reduces eye strain, even during extended use. The 12GB DDR4 memory enables smooth operation of multiple applications simultaneously, while the 256GB SSD provides rapid data access and boosts overall system efficiency.
